name: Dev-via-spec Reviewer Rejected — Retry Planner
description: When the dev-via-spec-reviewer emits decide(action=insufficient), respawn the dev-via-spec-planner with the reviewer's gaps. The planner reads the gaps via read_loop_result on the reviewer loop and addresses them on the next pass. Bounded by max_iterations=5; same per-entity rule-state caveat as the research-arc analogue rules — each reviewer loop is a new entity, so the budget is informational and the mock-llm fixture sequence determines termination in this e2e. R3.3 of the ADR-031 phasing.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.dev-via-spec-plan-retry
on_enter.prompt: The dev-via-spec reviewer rejected the prior plan. Reviewer loop id: $entity.instance. Call read_loop_result with that loop id to read the gap list (the reviewer's decide reason field), then revise the plan per your `20-revision-rules.md`. Keep goal and context unchanged unless the reviewer specifically flagged them. Re-emit decide(action=planned, reason="<revised plan>").

metadata.stop_condition: Q2 — MaxIter (=5) + reviewer + opt-in human gate
metadata.max_iterations_note: Per-entity rule-state caveat carries over from the research-arc rules. Each reviewer loop is a distinct entity, so this budget is informational under the current rule engine. Mock-llm fixture sequence determines termination in e2e; real-LLM runs rely on the planner's revision discipline + the reviewer's strict checklist.
